tasks.short: Supervise patients' delegated work or arts-and-crafts activities

steps.what: Locate and read the actual patient's current delegated activity, relevant limits and therapist instructions through the existing patient/activity view
inputs: Actual current therapist delegation and activity instructions
outputs: Located and read actual delegated activity and limits

steps.what: Actually supervise the patient in choosing among the delegated suitable activities and completing the work or craft project, observing the patient's response and seeking the therapist when the situation exceeds the delegation
inputs: Actual delegation and limits from s1
Actual patient, materials and current response
outputs: Actual supported patient activity and observed response

steps.what: Write and check the actually required activity note, recording what the patient chose and did, the help provided and observed response without adding a clinical interpretation
inputs: Actual activity and observations from s2
outputs: Complete checked factual aide activity-note draft

steps.what: Save the factual aide draft in the same review workspace without formally attesting it as a therapist's clinical entry
inputs: Complete actual note draft from s3
outputs: Stored exact aide draft for existing therapist review

steps.what: Perform the existing therapist review of the aide's completed factual note and decide whether that exact entry can be clinically attested under the actual supervision route
inputs: Exact completed aide draft from s4
Actual delegation and relevant patient context
outputs: Therapist decision on that exact completed entry or required correction

steps.what: Formally attest only the exact therapist-reviewed aide entry through the existing clinical record route
inputs: Exact completed aide entry from s4
Current therapist review decision from s5
outputs: Actual formally attested clinical activity entry or no attestation

tasks.design: Configure current delegated-activity lookup in {OPS_SYSTEM}, retaining patient-specific reading, actual craft/work supervision and separately written factual observations. {OTHER} means the patient, actual craft/work materials and treatment space; the existing therapist retains clinical review and formal attestation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The aide may navigate several existing patient/activity screens to find the current delegated instructions.
tasks.enabler_now: A native current-activity view may shorten navigation while displaying the actual therapist instructions.
tasks.still_hard: The patient's response, appropriate assistance and the boundary of the delegation require direct human supervision.
tasks.human_edge: The aide observes and supports the actual person and recognises when the therapist is needed.

ambition.what: Find the existing delegation more readily without automating patient supervision or clinical decisions.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; confirm existing patient-record access and the actual supervision/documentation route with the therapist and system owner

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native patient/activity views can aid instruction lookup; actual patient coaching and responsible therapist review remain human work, with no measured time claim.

assumptions: This represents an actual supervised activity episode with a required factual aide note and existing therapist review/attestation. It does not invent a note or new approval after every craft interaction; map the actual local documentation route if different.

s1 counts reading the actual current delegation, not a termly setup charged to each patient. The therapist's original care/activity planning is existing upstream clinical work, unchanged and not claimed as a new structured feed or saving.

The aide's actual observations are produced in s2 and written in s3 only after the activity. No transcript, inferred patient response or automatic clinical interpretation is assumed. Native note templates are considered but no extra note-writing saving is asserted.

s4 is an ordinary same-system draft save at minimum integer share1 for negligible effort, fully retained and ungated, with no author self-approval. s5 is the actual therapist reviewing someone else's completed factual draft. s6 is separate formal clinical attestation, fully retained, not a saving assigned to ordinary filing. The exact entry exists before s5; any edit voids a1.

Focal baseline94 retained92: gross2/94*100=2.1277 minus0.5 upkeep=1.6277. Therapist review/attestation6 remains counted at6.3830 per100 focal hours and is not saved or deducted again. Shares are unmeasured actual-work estimates independent of the prior.
Existing native activity views already in use earn no new gain. No new treatment selection, diagnostic action or written external communication is hidden in the supervision or draft save.
unknowns: Whether the actual patient/activity view already supplies current delegation directly
Existing factual-note and therapist attestation route
research_questions: Observe actual patient-specific lookup, supervision, factual note writing, ordinary draft save and existing therapist review separately.

already_counted.description: Aide's actual delegation reading, patient supervision, factual note writing and ordinary draft save
Actual existing therapist review of the aide's note and formal clinical attestation

incremental.description: Maintain current delegated-activity links without creating a second patient record

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete factual aide entry from s3/s4 reviewed by the existing responsible therapist; any change voids attestation authority

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:10 lookup points at80% retained saves2/94*100=2.1277 points minus0.5 upkeep=1.6277, rounded down. Low: the patient/activity identifiers do not expose the current delegation version, retaining all10 lookup points; keep original manual instruction lookup without new helper upkeep. Patient supervision, actual note writing, ordinary draft save, therapist review and formal attestation remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: The actual responsible occupational therapist retains delegation, clinical review and formal attestation
skills_to_grow: Read the current actual delegation and limits
Record factual patient activity without adding clinical interpretation
Distinguish ordinary draft saving from responsible clinical attestation
role.ambitious_version: An aide who locates actual delegated instructions more readily while retaining direct patient support, factual observation and close therapist supervision.
